questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Summary against list

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: On a site visit, a designer summarizes the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: No, it merely repeats the drill names.
No, it adds a new unrelated claim.
options.misconception: overstates the claim in the summary

options.text: Yes, because it lists the drills again.
options.misconception: reads stance from facts not diction

options.text: Yes, it compresses the list into one point.

questions.explanation: The final clause compresses the list into one point. The key is D, "Yes, it compresses the list into one point". Option A ("No, it merely repeats the drill names") is wrong: mistakes detail for main idea. Option B ("No, it adds a new unrelated claim") is wrong: overstates the claim in the summary. Option C ("Yes, because it lists the drills again") is wrong: reads stance from facts not diction.
